details:
Open-source vector similarity search for Postgres. Supports L2 distance, inner product, and cosine distance  

Security Fix(es):  

  * pgvector: pgvector: Arbitrary code execution via out-of-bounds write during IVFFlat index build (CVE-2026-103484)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
